content: And from human evaluation results shown in Table TABREF36 , our model gets the best average rank in irony accuracy. And as mentioned above, the DualRL model usually does not change the input sentence and outputs the same sentence. Therefore, it is reasonable that it obtains the best rank in sentiment and content preservation and ours is the second. However, it still demonstrates that our model, instead of changing nothing, transfers the style of the input sentence with content and sentiment preservation at the same time.
